reasons: The inspected evidence supports substantial coverage of direct force control, estimate-driven reference and impedance adaptation, learned actions, motion compensation, and execution conditions. The four declared development traces distinguish demonstrated mechanisms from future work and permit parallel evolution.

A concrete, directly relevant historical lead remains inadequately resolved: the 2018 tele-echography paper dleAw10hhQkJ links pre-contact anticipation, online perceived-stiffness estimation, robot effective mass, force-control adaptation, and clinical validation. Its abstract establishes relevance, but does not establish the detailed mechanism or its limitations. Broad overlap with estimate-driven control is insufficient to decide whether its interface changes the current capability and bottleneck account.

The Controller confirmed that the bound Map and Evidence contain no dedicated original-source analysis of this interface. The supplied representatives address different interfaces and cannot currently resolve that question.

transition_causality.rationale: All four declared traces were reviewed. Reference inconsistency motivates constrained reference adaptation; lumped force uncertainty motivates observer compensation; divergent interactions motivate coordinated feedforward and impedance adaptation; and explicitly reported DOSMAC limitations motivate the inspected predictive extension. Conditions, residual limitations, and distinctions between mechanism relationships and documented author lineage are preserved.

The unresolved source limits coverage without presently establishing a contradiction in those explanations.
